2: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, you that lead Joseph like a flock; you that dwell between the cherubims, shine forth.
3: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up your strength, and come and save us.
4: Turn us again, O God, and cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.
5: O LORD God of hosts, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
6: You feed them with the bread of tears; and give them tears to drink in great measure.
7: You make us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
8: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.
9: You have brought a vine out of Egypt: you have cast out the heathen, and planted it.
10: You prepared room before it, and did cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
11: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
12: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
13: Why have you then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
14: The boar out of the wood does waste it, and the wild beast of the field does devour it.
15: Return, we plead to you, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
16: And the vineyard which your right hand has planted, and the branch that you made strong for yourself.
17: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of your countenance.
18: Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand, upon the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
19: So will not we go back from you: quicken us, and we will call upon your name.
20: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.
